SELECT
  order_id,
  order_date,
  last_day(order_date) AS month_end,
  CASE WHEN month(order_date) >= 4 THEN year(order_date) + 1 ELSE year(order_date) END AS fiscal_year,
  ((month(order_date) + 8) % 12) // 3 + 1 AS fiscal_qtr,
  strftime(order_date, '%A') AS dow
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }}

explanation: This procedure rebuilds a fiscal calendar table from the orders table, with one row per order. For each order it adds the last day of the order's month, a fiscal year that starts in April (so April to December take the next calendar year), a fiscal quarter, and the English weekday name. The model keeps every order row, including duplicates, and returns the same six columns in the same order.
